{{Version|2.2.23|0.95|
* New Value Pack Order}}
[[File:Store Button.png|frameless|left]]
The store allows you to buy [[Store#Value_Packs|Value Packs]], [[Store#Perk_Bundles|Perk Bundles]], [[Store#Perks|Perks]], [[Store#Resource_Packs|Resource Packs]], [[Store#Gem_Unlocks|Gem Unlocks]], [[Store#Gem_Upgrades|Gem Upgrades]], and [[Store#Gem_Packs|Gem Packs]].

{{clear|left}}
== Freebie Pack ==
The Freebie Pack is the primary method of earning {{Sprites|Gem||x20}}, {{Sprites|Item Chest|Chests#Item_Chests|x20}}, {{Sprites|Relic Chest|Chests#Relic_Chests|x20}}, and {{Sprites|Skill Bit|Skill-Tree|x20}}. All of these resources can also be earned from [[Events|Events]] and other game mechanisms, but the Freebie Pack is the biggest source over time.

===Cooldown===
The Freebie Pack can be claimed every 10 minutes by default (affected by game speed), but this cooldown can be [[Stats#tabber-Freebie_Cooldown|reduced]] down to 6 minutes and 4 seconds as a F2P player and 5 minutes and 4 seconds with IAPs.

===Banking===
The Freebie Pack can be "banked." Banking allows you to hold multiple Freebie Packs before needing to claim them, allowing you to wait longer in between claims without missing out on rewards. You can bank 2 Freebies by default, and this can be [[Stats#tabber-Banked_Freebie_Cap|increased]] to 184 as a F2P player and 304 with IAPs.

===Gems===
The Freebie Pack provides 5 gems by default; this can be [[Stats#tabber-Bonus_Gems_From_Freebie_Pack|increased]] to 86 as a F2P player and 116 with IAPs.

===Item Chests===
The Freebie Pack provides 1 [[Chests#Item_Chests|Item Chest]], and there are currently no ways to increase this.

===Relic Chests===
The Freebie Pack provides a 10% chance at a [[Chests#Relic_Chests|Relic Chest]]. This can be increased by:
* +1% from the [[Skill-Tree|"Gems & Chests" Skill]]
* The "[[Skill-Tree|Treasure Hunter]]" Skill
** Gives +1% Freebie Relic Chance for every 250 regular [[Chests#Relic_Chests|Relic Chests]] you've already opened

=== Bonus Relic Chest ===
A secondary, independent roll is also made combining 
* +15% from [[Chests#Relic_Chests|Relic Chest]] from the [[Store#Value_Packs|"Capitalist Bundle!" Value Pack]]
* [[Cards#tabber-Misc|Relic Misc Card]] 1% for the base card, +1% for Gilding it, +1% for making the card Polychrome, and even further increases beyond that via Infernals.

===Skill Bits===
The Freebie Pack provides a 10% chance at a [[Skill-Tree|Skill Bit]]. 10 [[Skill-Tree|Skill Bits]] can be combined into 1 [[Skill-Tree|Skill Point]]. This can be increased by:
*+1% from the platinized [[Construct#tabber-World_1_Platinized_Statues|Statue of Friendship]]
*+1% from a [[Challenges#tabber-Regular_2|Regular Challenge Upgrade]]
*+1% from the [[Store#Value_Packs|"Skill Surge Bundle" Value Pack]]

===Misc===
Some unlocks give a random chance to provide more loot: 
* [[Stats#tabber-Instant_Refresh_Chance|Instant Refreshes]] instantly make the Freebie pack claimable again. The chance for an Instant Refresh maxes at 6% for F2P players, and 7% with IAPs.
* The base/gilded/platinized [[Construct#Statues|Statue of Soprano]] provides a 0.5/0.75/1% chance for a [[Store#Gifts|Gift]] and a one in 50k/35/25k chance for 100 [[Store#Gifts|Gifts]]
* [[Stats#tabber-Chance_For_Freebie_Jackpot|Freebie Jackpots]] roll freebies five times instead of once. The additional rolls cannot roll Jackpots themselves, nor can they roll Instant Refreshes, Gifts, or Stonks rewards. Freebie Jackpot Chance maxes at 11% for F2P players and 17% with IAPs.

===Stonks===
The [[Skill-Tree#Stonks|Stonks Skill]] provides a 1% chance for +200 gems, 1% for +20 [[Chests#Item_Chests|Item Chests]], and 1% for +10 [[Chests#Relic_Chests|Relic Chests]] by default. The [[Stats#tabber-Stonks_Chance|Stonks Chance]] can be increased by the [[Cards#tabber-Pets|Infernal Happy-Bot Pet Card]], as well as the [[Construct#World_4_Bonuses|Statue of Combat]]. Furthermore, the Stonks rewards can also be increased by the [[Stats#tabber-Stonks_Freebie_Multiplier|Stonks Freebie Multiplier]] as well as [[Stats#tabber-All_Stonks_Multiplier|All Stonks Multiplier]].

===Super Stonks===
The [[Stats#tabber-Super_Stonks_Chance|Super Stonks]] is an extra multiplier on top of regular Stonks and requires Stonks to be rolled in order to have a chance at rolling the Super Stonks. Super Stonks provides a base multiplier of x2, which can be further increased by the [[Stats#tabber-Super_Stonks_Multiplier|Super Stonks Multiplier]] as well as [[Stats#tabber-All_Stonks_Multiplier|All Stonks Multiplier]].<br>
Super Stonks Chance needs to be unlocked. The first potential sources are [[Black hole|Black Hole 3]] or [[Challenges#tabber-Divine_2|Divine Challenge 7]].

===Ultra Stonks===
The [[Stats#tabber-Ultra_Stonks_Chance|Ultra Stonks]] is an extra multiplier on top of Super Stonks and requires Super Stonks to be rolled in order to have a chance at rolling the Ultra Stonks. Ultra Stonks provides a base multiplier of x25, which can be further increased by [[Stats#tabber-All_Stonks_Multiplier|All Stonks Multiplier]].<br>
Ultra Stonks Chance needs to be unlocked. The first potential sources are [[Black hole|Black Hole 17]] or the [[Construct#World_4_Bonuses|Statue of Combat]].

==Value Packs== 
These bundles are in the order they appear in game. Purchasing {{Sprite|FounderIcon|Founder|16|Founder}} status allows you to see the next two Value Packs instead of only one. You can use the [[codes|code]] <code>{{Sprite|Misc Code||16|MOREVP}}</code>, <code>{{Sprite|Misc Code||16|MOREVPS}}</code>, or <code>{{Sprite|Misc Code||16|CHOICEPARALYSIS}}</code> to see 20. If you do not meet the requirements for a Value Pack then it is skipped and the next one in line is displayed. Once you meet the requirements, the skipped value pack will appear.

== Gifts ==

Each of these rolls can stack, up to a total 1500x Loot Multiplier. Sticker rolls are capped at 150 Stickers (75% max chance).

==Founders Bundle== 
{{See also|Founder}}
After purchasing all Perk Bundles, the Founders Bundle will appear. It will include:

*3500 Gems
*250 [[Chests#Relic_Chests|Relic Chests]]
*4 [[Chests#Relic_Chests|Mythic Chests]]
*Founder Supply Drops
*VIP Lounge Access
*[[Bombs#tabber-Founders_Bomb|Founders Bomb]]
*x1.25 Pickaxe Damage
*x1.25 Bomb Damage
*x1.25 Exp Gain
*x1.10 Bomb Recharge Rate
*10x [[Craft Chance]] +2%
*+100 Bomb Capacity
*-1 Min Cooldown Freebie Pack
*Offline Cap 12 hours > 24 hours
*Founders Stats Page + Badge
*Founder Status Discord Rank

==Gem Unlocks== 
Gem Unlocks allow you to unlock an extra drone and three different types of bombs with your gems:

*Permanent Drone
**Gives an additional [[Drones|Drone]] that will automatically mine your ore even when you are offline.
**Costs 200 gems.

*Unlock Bomb: [[Bombs#tabber-MEGABOMB|MEGABOMB]]
**Deals 25x damage to all ores on short cooldown
**Costs 500 gems.

*Unlock Bomb: [[Bombs#tabber-Transmuter_Bomb|Transmuter Bomb]]
**Marks ores to drop bars, scales with rock size
**Costs 750 gems.

*Unlock Bomb: [[Bombs#tabber-Battery_Bomb|Battery Bomb]]
**Charges 2 random bombs, 0.1% to increase all bomb caps by 1
** Costs 1,000 gems.
